title: Composition coherence of normalized scalar/pullback comparisons
statement: For any map φ:A→B of commutative rings and composable scheme maps j1:X→T1, v:T1→T2 with j1 v=j2, the canonical K-flat-normalized scalar/pullback maps of [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection] commute with the canonical inverse-image composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition-module-linear]. Write λ_f for scalarPullbackIso transported along Lf*=D(f*) and a_D:j2*_D≅v*_D followed by j1*_D. For every unbounded derived A-module sheaf N on T2, a_B(Q_T2 N) followed by j1*_B(λ_v(N)) followed by λ_j1(v*_A N) equals λ_j2(N) followed by Q_X(a_A(N)). No finiteness, properness, openness, boundedness, or coefficient flatness is assumed.

The two unit equations and naturality of the second restriction square express its transpose as the pasted restriction square after the first scalar unit. theorem scalarPullback_composition
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X T₁ T₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    (v : T₁ ⟶ T₂) (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂) (h : j₁ ≫ v = j₂)
    (N : DerivedCategoryModule A T₂) :
    (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
          (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j₁ v j₂ h.symm) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).hom.app ((scalarExtension φ T₂).obj N) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j₁).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) v).symm ≪≫
        scalarPullbackIso φ v ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v) _).hom.app N) ≫
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j₁).symm ≪≫
        scalarPullbackIso φ j₁ ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₁) _).hom.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).mapDerivedCategory.obj N) =
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j₂).symm ≪≫
        scalarPullbackIso φ j₂ ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₂) _).hom.app N ≫
        (scalarExtension φ X).map
          ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
              (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₁ v j₂ h.symm) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).hom.app N)
